messages:
Marta: Heads-up — Holocene Health wants traffic pinned to eu-west-1 for their EU pilot and a proxy allowlist. Theyre also asking for a short demo throughput bump and want a renewal cost review scheduled (renewal in ~8 weeks).
cam_net: Okay. do we have their source IPs and ops contact? need ASN/CIDR and LOA to open peering/proxy ACLs.
Marta: ops: infra@holocene.health. CIDRs they provided: 198.51.100.128/26, 203.0.113.64/27. Demo window: 2026-07-05T09:00Z -> 2026-07-09T17:00Z.
Riley_se: current rate is 75/min per route. suggest temporary 350/min for demo and a dedicated route to stabilize KV/prefix cache. recommend pre-warm 12h before demo.
Vik_ops: ephemeral allowlist ok. propose TTL 12 days, auto-revoke 2026-07-21T09:00Z UTC. We'll notify CSM 24h before revoke. Can infra apply route pin + ACLs once LOA attached?
Marta: LOA uploaded to ticket #INC-88921. Please use this route config as single source of truth:
```
route: /v1/generate/holocene
region_pin: eu-west-1
route_mode: dedicated
rate_limit: 350/min
kv_cache_warm: true
allowlist_cidrs: [198.51.100.128/26, 203.0.113.64/27]
ephemeral_ttl_days: 12
auto_revoke_at: 2026-07-21T09:00Z
notes: "Demo 2026-07-05 to 2026-07-09; schedule renewal cost walkthrough"
```
deploy-bot: network-change queued for customer=holocene, change_id=chg_hc_20260705_01, status=queued
Nina_csm: I'll set up the renewal cost walkthrough and a short post-demo feedback survey (latency, error-rate, perceived quality). tagging @Riley_se for perf numbers.
Vik_ops: Approved. will set auto-notify 24h prior and revoke on 2026-07-21T09:00Z.
